मशीन पहचान जीवनचक्र

The complete set of processes for creating, managing, renewing, and retiring machine identities (e.g., certificates, keys) across IT assets to ensure proper authentication and authorization.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, MITRE ATT&CK and published by Protermify Cybersecurity as a static cybersecurity reference page.

Definition

The complete set of processes for creating, managing, renewing, and retiring machine identities (e.g., certificates, keys) across IT assets to ensure proper authentication and authorization.

Operational example

SOC teams must track the machine identity lifecycle to avoid certificate expiration, which could disrupt critical encrypted communications.
